name: מערכת משוואות – מעגל וישר, נקודות חיתוך (באנגלית)
questiontext:
Find the values of \(x\) and \(y\), from the following expressions.

\[ \left. \begin{array}{rcl} {{CT:0}} &=&{{CT:1}} \\ {{CT:2}} &=&{{CT:3}} \end{array} \right\} \]

Give your answer as a set containing the pairs of points which satisfy the equation, e.g. \(\left( \left\{[x_1, y_1],[x_2, y_2] \right\}\right)\):

\([x,y] \in \) [[input:ans]]
[[validation:ans]]
generalfeedback:
Outline: Express \(y\) from the linear equation, substitute it into the quadratic equation, solve the resulting quadratic in \(x\), and find \(y\) for each root.
Step 1 — Rearranging the linear equation
By rearranging the linear equation, \({{CT:2}} = {{CT:3}} \) we obtain:

\[ y = {{CT:4}}, \]

Step 2 — Substituting into the quadratic
which we can substitute into the quadratic to give:

\[ {{CT:5}} = {{CT:1}}. \]

This can be rearranged into the more familiar quadratic form:

\[ {{CT:6}} = 0. \]

Step 3 — Solving the quadratic
Dividing by \(2\):

\[ x^2-2x-3=0 \]

We need two numbers whose product is \(-3\) and whose sum is \(-2\): they are \(-3\) and \(1\), so

\[ (x-3)(x+1)=0 \]

Solving this gives \( x = 3\) or \(x = -1 \).
Step 4 — The points
By substituting these back into the linear equation you can find the corresponding values of y. ( \(y = -1\) and \(y = 3\) respectively). Therefore, the solution set is:

\[ (x,y) \in \left\{ [3,-1] , [-1,3] \right\}. \]
